claude_proposed_widenings.name: RollKind: "ability_check"
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Guidance modifies ability checks. The current RollKind union only covers 'attack_roll' and 'saving_throw'. Adding 'ability_check' is the minimum required to encode any roll modifier on ability checks.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the creature adds 1d4 to any ability check using the chosen skill

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RollModifierOperation: optional skill scope field
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Guidance scopes its bonus to a single skill chosen at cast time. RollModifierOperation has no field to express this constraint. A new optional field (e.g., 'skillScope: ChosenAtCast | null') is needed so the encoding is honest about which checks receive the bonus.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you choose a skill. Until the spell ends, the creature adds 1d4 to any ability check using the chosen skill
